The sprawling area of the college campus is 277 acres. There are a total number of 509 faculty members at the college. PGIMER Chandigarh
Admission
PGIMER Chandigarh admissions are offered at UG, PG, and doctoral levels. Students need to appear for the INI CET/PGIMER Paramedical examination as per the course specific requirement. Eligible students need to visit the official website to take PGIMER Chandigarh admission at the desired course.
Admissions at
Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research Chandigarh
are offered for
B.Sc, B.Optom, BPT,
MDS, M.Sc, MS, MD, DM, and M.Ch
courses.
The
INI CET application fee
for PGIMER admissions is
Rs 4,000 for general OBC candidates
and
Rs 3,200 for SC/ST/EWS
candidates.
INICET Jan 2027 registrations
are ongoing, and the last date to apply is
October 13, 2026

The institute entrance test determines who gets selected for the B.Sc. Nursing and Post Basic B.Sc Nursing programmes at
PGIMER Chandigarh
. Candidates are required to take the INI CET exam to get PGIMER admissions to the various courses of postgraduate and doctoral level. To get admission to the PGIMER MDS course, applicants must receive a passing score on an entrance exam held by the Institute, under the PGIMER admission requirements. To complete the PGIMER Chandigarh admission process the candidate should submit the required documents along with the payment of the course fee.

Submit academic details, upload documents as per the specified format and pay the application fee.

For PGI Chandigarh login, candidates must use their username and password to access details. Candidates can access academic and personal information using the PGIMER student portal.

PGIMER Admission Process for PG Courses
Take the INI CET, get a passing grade and meet the INI CET cutoff standards.
Candidates must register and take part in INI CET counselling if they meet the eligibility requirements for the cutoff score.
Enter college preferences in the appropriate order.
Candidates will be shortlisted for PGIMER admissions based on INI CET results, selections made, and categories.
Visit the campus of PGIMER Chandigarh once you have been assigned.
Candidates should submit the necessary documents along with payment of the PGIMER admission fee to complete the admission process.

PGIMER Admission Process for Doctoral Courses
Candidates must take the INI CET and acquire a passing score.
Admissions are offered to candidates who meet the PGIMER INI CET cutoff.
Participate in INI CET counselling by registering.
Fill out the college selection form and pick PGIMER Chandigarh as your top preference.
Candidates are assigned colleges based on their INI CET score, category, and choices.
Visit the campus of PGIMER Chandigarh after admission is granted.
To complete the PGIMER admission procedure, candidates should submit the documents, and paying the course fee is the final step.
PGIMER Counselling
Candidates are required to use the INICET registration portal to attend the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research Chandigarh for all India basis level. In the PGIMER counselling process, candidates are required to list the desired courses and colleges based on their preferences.
PGIMER Results
Candidates must visit the official website of the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research Chandigarh to check PGIMER results. The results are uploaded in a PDF format with names and ranks. To check results and other details, candidates must log in to the PGIMER student portal using their username and password.
